operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-48, HS-01, and HS-02)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall only be operated in situations that arise from sudden and reasonably unforeseeable events where the primary energy or power source is disrupted or disconnected (e.g., electrical grid failure, on-site disaster, public service emergencies); for participation in an ISO-declared emergency (e.g., abnormal system conditions, capacity deficiency, fuel shortage, abnormal natural events, external ISO events); for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT); for unscheduled maintenance, testing, and operational training; and for the integration operational period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-48, HS-01, and HS-02)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Except for during the integrational operational period, no emergency diesel engine gen-set shall be operated for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), stack testing, or operational training (that involves fuel combustion) between the hours of 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30.

operationalLimits.category: Ozone Season Operating Restrictions (Integration Operational Period)
operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-48, HS-01, and HS-02)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: During the integration operational period, any operation of the unit (that involves fuel combustion) between the hours of 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during the ozone season of May 1 through September 30 shall only occur if the forecast Air Quality Index (AQI) for ozone as published on the AirNow website for Northern Virginia for that day is less than or equal to 100. If an Air Alert is issued for Northern Virginia/DC area for a day with forecasted AQI less than or equal to 100, operation shall be minimized to the maximum extent practical.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-48, HS-01, and HS-02)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 35 hours per year for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT). Annual limits are calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-48, HS-01, and HS-02)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 500 hours per year for all purposes combined. Annual limits are calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-48, HS-01, and HS-02)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: The approved fuel is diesel fuel oil, defined as ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil (ULSD), renewable diesel, or a blend of these fuels. Shall meet ASTM D975 for grade ultra-low sulfur 1-D S15 or grade 2-D S15; or has a maximum sulfur content not to exceed 0.0015% by weight (15 ppm), and either a minimum cetane number of forty (40) or maximum aromatic content of thirty-five percent (35%) by volume.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. EG-01 through EG-48, HS-01, and HS-02) combined
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall consume no more than 716,654 gallons of diesel fuel, calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period (all uses). Compliance is demonstrated daily by adding the total for the most recently completed calendar day to the individual daily totals for the preceding 364 days.
